info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Loan Application Modification API
info.description: The Loan Application Modification API allows users to update the details of existing loan applications efficiently. This endpoint is vital for financial institutions and loan officers who need to make adjustments to loan application information based on new data or customer requests. Common use cases include modifying borrower details, changing loan terms, or updating application statuses. By utilizing this API, users can ensure that loan applications are kept up-to-date, reflecting accurate and current information.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific loan application identified by its unique reference number. Use this endpoint to modify any information related to the loan application as needed.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit partial updates to the loan application identified by RES-100045. It contains the fields that need to be updated along with their new values.
